snippet.title: Why cowboys only loaded five bullets
snippet.description: The old sheriff hands a single bullet to the young gunslinger who came to kill him: "You're going to need all six, son." The whole saloon laughs. The kid has won 12 duels in 12 towns, and before every one he spins his revolver and smacks it into his holster. By sundown the whole town is betting against the sheriff, and the undertaker has already measured him for a coffin. Then comes high noon. A made-up story with a real reason: on old single-action six-shooters the firing pin sat on the hammer, so with all six chambers loaded it rested right on a cartridge, and a hard knock to the hammer could fire the gun. Cowboys loaded five and kept the hammer down on the empty chamber.

snippet.title: How I make Carne en su Jugo! Easy homemade recipe !! Dinner idea ♥️
snippet.description:
🍴Recipe: 
2lbs skirt steak 
1 lb bacon 
Serrano peppers 
Knob onions 
Spanglis asadero all purpose seasoning
1-2 cups frijoles de la olla 
Salsa 
8 tomatillos 
1 large garlic 
1 large jalapeño
Cilantro 
2 Tbsp knorr beef bouillon 
2 cups water 
@SpanglishAsadero @knorr 
Start by cooking the bacon until crispy. Use the bacon grease to cook Serrano peppers and knob onions 6-8 mins. 
In the same bacon grease add your steak. Season with seasoning cover and cook 10-15 mins. In a blender add tomatillos, garlic, jalapeno, cilantro, beef bouillon and 2 cups water. Then add salsa to skillet , plus 1 more cup of water. Add onions,  Serrano peppers and half of the bacon. Cover and cook 10 mins. Then add beans. I added about 1 1/2 cups. Salt to taste cover and cook 10 mins . 
Top with onion, cilantro, avocado, radishes and bacon . 
Enjoy! 
#cooking #foodie #homemade #mexicanfood #easyrecipe

snippet.title: 外国人が日本の空港で驚く3つのこと
snippet.description:
飛行機を降りて荷物を受け取るとき、日本の空港のさりげない気配りに驚く外国の人は少なくありません。
世界の空港では荷物の遅れや紛失などが年間およそ3340万件（2024年・SITA調べ）あるといわれていますが、関西国際空港などの現場ではこんな丁寧な仕事が続けられています。
・1つ目：スーツケースの持ち手を受け取る人のほうへそろえ、壊れやすい楽器やベビーカーは直接手渡すことも
・2つ目：強い雨で濡れた荷物をタオルで拭き取り、ベルトの枠にぶつからないよう手を添える気配り
・3つ目：関西国際空港は1994年の開港以来、空港が原因の荷物紛失が一度もなく、SKYTRAXの手荷物部門で通算8度の世界一（2024年時点）
どれが一番意外でしたか？空港でうれしかった気配りがあれば、ぜひコメントで教えてくださいね。
